يرتهنان (form VIII)
# يَرْتَهِنَانِ (yartahināni) /jar.ta.hi.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# يُرْتَهَنَانِ (yurtahanāni) /jur.ta.ha.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
